failure_type: late detection and high speed combined with sensor noise and planner randomness
explanation: The UAV collided with a late-appearing obstacle because it only detected the object at 6.6 seconds, leaving only 0.8 seconds to react. The failure was confirmed to be preventable by reducing the cruise speed, eliminating sensor noise, or using different random seeds for the planner. The short sensing range of 6.4 meters significantly limited the time available for the UAV to maneuver around the obstacle.
